summary: Added Q4_1 tensor support to the out-of-core streamed CPU decoder by admitting GGML_TYPE_Q4_1 to the decoder's tensor-type gate. Dequantization (to_float) and the matrix-vector dot kernel (vec_dot through the Q8_1 activation path) remain delegated to the pinned ggml reference traits, so no hand-written quantization is introduced. Real native inference on a 16 MB Q4_1 Stories15M model produces output byte-identical to the resident llama.cpp reference over 16 greedy tokens, and runs out-of-core under a 22-24 MB address-space limit at ~14.3 MB peak RSS.

change_rationale.gate: native/src/streamed.cpp Decoder::tensor rejected any type outside {F32,Q8_0,Q4_0}; Q4_1 was the only missing 32-element-block affine quant with a complete pinned reference kernel.
change_rationale.block_geometry: Q4_1 QK=32, so the existing 'columns % 32 == 0' check is already correct; no geometry change needed.
change_rationale.kernels: ggml_get_type_traits(Q4_1)->to_float = dequantize_row_q4_1; ggml_get_type_traits_cpu(Q4_1)->vec_dot with vec_dot_type Q8_1 (from_float present). Both are the locked reference implementations; the decoder adds no arithmetic of its own.
change_rationale.rust_side: crates/llmbridge-core/src/gguf_index.rs tensor_layout already mapped Q4_1 to (block 32, 20 bytes), so the authenticated indexer already accepted Q4_1; only the C++ decoder gate was restrictive.
change_rationale.abi: No ABI change. Entry points llmbridge_generate_streamed_cpu[_v2/_v3] and llmbridge_inspect_streamed_plan_v1 keep their signatures; ABI version unchanged.

numerical_parity.method: Deterministic greedy (argmax) token-sequence comparison, single thread, identical prompt/context/tokenizer. The streamed decoder is an independent custom FP32 forward pass (its own RMSNorm/RoPE/attention/softmax/residual); only per-row dequant+dot are shared ggml kernels. Exact multi-token agreement with the resident llama.cpp graph is therefore a cross-implementation parity signal, not a tautology.
numerical_parity.streamed_q4_1_vs_streamed_q8_0: EXACT (16/16) on the same base weights
numerical_parity.streamed_q4_1_vs_streamed_q4_0: diverges at token 16 ('in' vs 'and'); expected and consistent: Q4_1 carries an affine min/bias term so it tracks the Q8_0 reference more closely than scale-only Q4_0.
numerical_parity.logit_level_diff: NOT MEASURED: the CLI exposes no per-token logit dump; parity here is deterministic-token-sequence level. A quantitative abs/rel logit-error harness is a documented gap (see limitations).

bounded_memory.interpretation: A 16 MB Q4_1 model streams ~91 MB of weight reads in <=65 KB ranges and runs in a 24 MB address space at ~14.3 MB peak RSS. Out-of-core bounded memory is preserved for Q4_1; weights are never fully resident.

remaining_blockers.k_quants: streamed.cpp:71 allowlist plus the block-geometry check (which assumes 32-element blocks) would need to admit 256-element superblocks (columns % 256 == 0). ggml supplies to_float and vec_dot (Q8_K activation) for Q4_K/Q5_K/Q6_K, and gguf_index.rs already carries their block geometry, so the kernel path is feasible. Blocker: no compatible K-quant llama model is available locally to validate real inference, and the engineering rule forbids declaring support without actual inference + reference comparison. Deferred rather than claimed.
remaining_blockers.modern_architectures: Qwen2/Llama-3 are blocked by several independent decoder assumptions: (1) the llama.* metadata allowlist rejects keys outside the 9 known (e.g. llama.vocab_size shipped by Llama-3); (2) the exact-tensor-count check rejects extra tensors such as Qwen2 attention q/k/v biases; (3) the RoPE implementation is normal (adjacent-pair) only, while Qwen2 uses NEOX-style rotation; (4) production weights are usually K-quant. Each is a separate, larger increment and is documented, not attempted.
remaining_blockers.logit_diff_harness: No per-token logit dump path exists in the CLI; a quantitative logit abs/rel error harness would strengthen parity beyond deterministic token agreement.

security_and_correctness_preserved.note: Only the tensor-type gate widened by one admitted type plus doc comments and a test. No change to authentication, sealed-manifest verification, mutation detection, deadline/cancellation, worker lifecycle, or memory admission. Finite-value checks (read_row/matvec require std::isfinite) apply to Q4_1 identically. ABI unchanged.

limitations: Tiny models only (<=26 MB); the Q4_1 fixture is 16 MB. No 100 MB - 2 GB compatible Q4_1 model was available to test scale.
Parity is deterministic-greedy-token-sequence level, not raw-logit numerical diff (no CLI logit dump).
WSL2 virtualized, not physical 2 GB/dual-core hardware; memory numbers are address-space/RSS bounds.
cgroup memory.max enforcement not re-tested here (no passwordless sudo in WSL2); RLIMIT_AS used as the enforced bound, consistent with prior evidence.
Windows native (MSVC) regression lane not run this session; native validation was performed under WSL2/gcc.
Fixtures are gitignored and not committed; reproduce by placing the listed sha256 fixtures under models/ and copying to a WSL-local path.
